name: checkout-page
scope: The new checkout page: cart summary, address form, payment step, confirmation. Lives in app/src/checkout and its tests in app/tests/checkout.
prove: Start the dev server on port 3100 with a throwaway database, run the browser specs under app/tests/e2e/checkout at 1920 by 1080, then walk every screen of the checkout in light and dark and screenshot each. Stop the server when done.
checkCommands: npm run typecheck, npx eslint on the changed files, npx vitest run on app/tests/checkout.
stackNotes: This is a Next.js app with TypeScript and Tailwind. Follow the tokens in docs/design-tokens.md. No dashes in user-facing text.
memoryRules: Run at most one dev server and one browser at a time. Stop both when done.
commonRules: Nothing a user reads carries an internal id or an agent name.
